summary: Added Enter navigation to the earliest later event day, preserved left/right behavior, and confirmed all four agenda tests pass.

files.desk:apps:agenda:
app 'Agenda'
task start()
  set events to []
  for each p in pages('calendar')
    add fields(p) to events
  done
  give {events: events, day: today()}
done
task key(s, k)
when k is 'left'
  set s.day to add_days(s.day, -1)
  or when k is 'right'
    set s.day to add_days(s.day, 1)
  or when k is 'enter'
    set later to []
    for each e in s.events
      when e.date > s.day
        add e.date to later
      done
    done
    set later to sort(unique(later))
    when count(later) > 0
      set s.day to first(later)
    done
  done
  give s
done
task draw(s)
  title('Agenda')
  show(1, 1, s.day & ' ' & weekday(s.day))
  set rows to []
  for each e in s.events
    when e.date is s.day
      add e.time & ' ' & e.title to rows
    done
  done
  set rows to sort(rows)
  when count(rows) is 0
    show(3, 1, '(no events)')
  done
  set r to 3
  for each l in rows
    when r <= 23
      show(r, 1, l)
    done
    set r to r + 1
  done
  help('Left/Right change day; Enter skips to next event day')
done
files.desk:apps:agenda-tests:
use 'desk:apps:agenda'

test 'it shows the events of today, by time'
  pretend today is '2026-12-01'
  pretend 'calendar:e1' holds 'date: 2026-12-01' & newline() & 'time: 15:00' & newline() & 'title: Dentist' & newline() & 'with: '
  pretend 'calendar:e2' holds 'date: 2026-12-01' & newline() & 'time: 09:30' & newline() & 'title: Standup' & newline() & 'with: team'
  launch 'desk:apps:agenda'
  check screen_line(1) is '2026-12-01 tuesday'
  check screen_line(3) is '09:30 Standup'
  check screen_line(4) is '15:00 Dentist'
done

test 'right goes to the next day'
  pretend today is '2026-12-01'
  launch 'desk:apps:agenda'
  press 'right'
  check screen_line(1) is '2026-12-02 wednesday'
  check screen_line(3) is '(no events)'
done
test 'enter picks the earliest later event day'
pretend today is '2026-12-01'
pretend 'calendar:e1' holds 'date: 2026-12-10' & newline() & 'time: 10:00' & newline() & 'title: Later' & newline() & 'with: '
pretend 'calendar:e2' holds 'date: 2026-12-03' & newline() & 'time: 08:00' & newline() & 'title: Soon' & newline() & 'with: '
launch 'desk:apps:agenda'
press 'enter'
check screen_line(1) is '2026-12-03 thursday'
done
test 'enter stays when there are no later events'
pretend today is '2026-12-01'
pretend 'calendar:e1' holds 'date: 2026-11-30' & newline() & 'time: 10:00' & newline() & 'title: Past' & newline() & 'with: '
launch 'desk:apps:agenda'
press 'enter'
check screen_line(1) is '2026-12-01 tuesday'
done
